COR-01.statement: Stage must react the transverse component of the full contact reaction, |R_perp| = N sqrt((cos th + mu cos beta sin th)^2 + (mu sin beta)^2), not mu N.
COR-01.evidence_status: analytical calculation; mu and N ranges are assumptions pending EXP-B01

COR-02.note: Holding power is independent of wire gauge (motor-constant scaling). Km values are bracketing assumptions until analysis/em_actuator.py and EXP-B03 establish them.

COR-03.statement: For a +/-0.5 mm PAGE disc, transverse stage radius 0.5 mm suffices for any roll; axial accommodation needed is r*cos(theta) (0.41 mm at 35 deg), not 0.71 mm.

COR-04.statement: Axial accommodation against an axial stiffness k modulates the normal force by k * r cos(theta) / sin(theta) ... at 0.5 mm page correction.

COR-05.statement: Report's |1-exp(-j w tau)| holds only for unity-gain instantaneous actuation. Servo phase lag adds equivalent delay; e.g. a 60 Hz, zeta 0.7 servo adds ~3.7 ms at 8 Hz.

COR-07.statement: Report's 1 mg example understates the problem; a 0.1 deg attitude error leaks ~1.7 mg of gravity (8.6 mm after 1 s). IMU is useful only over the optical latency window (ms).

COR-08.assumptions: design point N=1 N, mu=0.15, theta=50 deg; 65% pen-down duty; 0.06 W electronics; dynamic tremor currents excluded (see sim results)

COR-09.statement: Normal approximation gives 32; exact paired t gives slightly more before attrition.
